faqs.question: What is the scope of MBA?
faqs.answer:
The scope of MBA course is increasing day by day. MBA is one of the big job oriented professional programme and the most one which has been sought by the students. Once you have completed your degree, you have a great job opportunity in the industrial world. You may the manager or executive in term of designation.
The management term is most suited to the managers and that's why it is the way, where you can reach on the top of the height as soon as possible by using your leadership and working proficiency. An MBA professional always plays a vital role in his/her company and this is why he used to keep in touch with the board of directors. No need to specify the companies who recruit the MBA professionals. All sectors including government and public have various industries, companies, institutions or related organizations, come in the job prospective fields for an MBA professional.
Some job profiles are listed here:
Brand Manager
Account Manager
International Business Manager
Marketing Executive
Business Technical Consultant
All the best.

faqs.question: Is the BTech Mechanical Engineering syllabus the same for all colleges?
faqs.answer:
The BTech Mechanical Engineering syllabus is not the same across all colleges, as every college committee sets a particular coursework pattern at the start of every academic year to be followed for the respective batch. The syllabus includes some core subjects, interesting electives, and lab work that gives detailed knowledge to the students about the workings of the field. 
Helpful Link: Mechanical Engineering Subjects in Detail

faqs.question: What do Electrical Engineering professionals do?
faqs.answer:
Electrical Engineering professionals are engineering jack of all trades, as they make use of their knowledge of Physics and Mathematics along with computer programming skills to develop intricate circuit systems. These circuit boards run electrical signals to and from electrical components to accomplish everything from a mundane computer startup to controlling absolute power and precision of a rocket going out of earth's atmosphere.

faqs.question: Which Medical fields offer the best work-life balance?
faqs.answer:
Some medical field which offe best work and life balance are shown below -
Dentistry (BDS & MDS) – Fixed clinic hours, fewer emergencies.
Pharmacy (BPharm & MPharm) – Less stress compared to hospital-based jobs.
Physiotherapy (BPT & MPT) – Flexible working hours, minimal emergency calls.
Public Health & Community Medicine – Focus on preventive healthcare rather than emergency treatments.
Clinical Research & Medical Writing – Research-based work with no direct patient responsibilities.

placements.overview: SVS Group of Institutions, Meerut is a private institute, established in 2010 in Meerut, Uttar Pradesh. SVS Group of Institutions, Meerut is approved by PCI and AICTE and offers a total of 12 courses at UG and PG levels in 6 specialisations such as Civil Engineering, Computer Science Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics & Communication Engineering and Home Science. Furthermore, it offer courses such as B.E. / B.Tech, MBA/PGDM, B.Sc., MCA and BCA in Full Time mode. SVS Group of Institutions, Meerut fee structure includes a total tuition fee ranging from INR 1,00,200 to 2,82,000. SVS Group of Institutions, Meerut has an annual seat intake of 696 for all the programmes. It offers courses, in streams such as Engineering, Medicine & Health Sciences, Business & Management Studies, IT & Software and Science. The institute has a safe and well-equipped campus with all the advanced facilities.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: My experience as an MCA student at the institute.

content.Placements: The placement rate at Modi Institute of Management and Technology in Kotak varies by program. The institute is known for maintaining a good placement record. Around 50% of top companies visit the campus annually including TCS, HCL, and Amazon. The highest salary package offered in this college is 11 LPA. The lowest salary package offered is approximately 1.2 LPA - 2.5 LPA. It depends on the source. The average salary package offered ranges between 4 LPA - 5 LPA. Top recruiting companies in this college are Wipro, Accenture, Amazon, and HCL Technologies. The institute has a modest record of providing internships. Some local companies and startups like the Bank of Baroda have been involved in providing internship opportunities to students. Top roles in the MCA course are typically aligned towards technical. The IT sector students have secured roles like software developer, system analyst, web developer, and data administration.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2020
individual_reviews.title: The college provides top-class facilities with a good placement ratio. I suggest others must join.

content.Placements: In our course, 72% of the students got placed. The highest salary package offered would be 15 LPA, and the lowest salary package offered is 6 LPA. I think for starting, a salary package of 6 LPA is also very good. Top recruiting companies for our course are Amazon, Facebook, Apple and Bain & Company. About 65% of the students got an internship. Top roles offered in this course are marketing manager, business operation manager and financial manager.
content.Infrastructure: Facilities are available, but they are not abundant. We have discussion groups and seminar halls to practice, but they are not well-maintained. Hostel rooms are good and well-maintained. Food is very good in the hostel, and the canteen offers a variety of food items and refreshments to choose. Our college has awesome sports facilities. We have football, a basketball court and a cricket ground too. Medical facilities are also available nearby.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2020
individual_reviews.title: I am satisfied because of faculty members, good placement in 2018 and very good infrastructure.

content.Placements: Almost 60 to 70% of the students from our course in the year 2018 were placed. The highest salary package offered is 11 LPA, the lowest salary package offered is 2.5 LPA and the average salary package offered is 4 LPA. Top recruiting companies of our college are Nestle India and various others. Students are offered roles like a financial manager and marketing manager. In our course, the highest salary package offered is 4 LPA, the lowest salary package offered is 1 LPA and the average salary package offered is 2 LPA. Approximately 55% of the students got an internship in various companies.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2013
individual_reviews.title: The best college in Kotak.

content.Placements: I got placed on campus. The college is the best in all aspects. Especially, the mentors engaged in this college are supportive and smart workers. Every student likes to get enrolled in this college for its quality education and campus placements.
content.Infrastructure: All the facilities provided in the college are awesome. The library is maintained well as the students can take proper guidance of the books necessary for examinations. The canteen is an awesome place. You can use the Wi-Fi facility for browsing the internet and online e-learning.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: Supportive faculty, good placements, and great campus life in the MBA.

content.Placements: Around 70-80% of students got placed from our MBA batch. The highest package offered was around 5-6 LPA, and the average package was approximately 2.5 LPA. Top recruiters included local startups. Many students got internships in finance and marketing roles.
content.Infrastructure: The college had good infrastructure with smart classrooms, a well-stocked library, computer labs, and campus Wi-Fi. The classrooms were spacious and clean. The food was average but hygienic, and basic medical and sports facilities were available. The overall environment was student-friendly.

Candidate who are appearing for the final year degree examination are also be eligible. Degree obtained by Distance Mode Program should have recognition by Joint Committee of UGC, AICTE and DEC/DEB. Candidate who passed all the subjects of the three years of any Degree course in one sitting is not eligible for admission.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Absolutely do not join this college.

content.Placements: Here, there have been no placements since 4 years ago; I think they had good placements then. Currently, there are no placements, and 0% of students are placed here. I suggest that if you want good internals and good marks in the lab, join here. If you want skill and good infrastructure, join here.
content.Infrastructure: Here, there are NEET and clean classrooms, but a low percentage of students. There is no canteen, no medical facilities, no games, and no hostel for boys. However, attendance and lab marks will be good. I am sharing my total experience and have suffered more. This is good for those who take more absences.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: This college is good for engineering.

content.Placements: 94% of students got placements. INR 24 LPA is the highest package. INR 8 LPA is the lowest package. The maximum number of students got jobs from CSE. There are different sections in the CSE branch—nearly 7 sections. There is no problem with placement; a talented student can definitely get a job.
content.Infrastructure: The college was superb, and it has a lot of blocks, and the CSE branch was the most demanded course in our college. Labs are always working with high-quality equipment and a Wi-Fi connection. Classrooms are the most important place for every student. Those were superb, and you can choose them blindly.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering - Batch of 2021
individual_reviews.title: Our college is good for lateral students.

content.Placements: About 65% of students from our course got placed on the campus. The highest salary package offered in our institution is 5 LPA. Top reputed companies like Tech Mahindra and HGS visit our college for placements. The top role offered in our course is a mechanical engineer.
content.Infrastructure: Our college provides average facilities. There is no Wi-Fi facility in the college. Labs and classrooms are good. The library is good in the whole college. There is no canteen in the college. The college is away from the hospitals. The college also conducts sports for the students.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering - Batch of 2017
individual_reviews.title: I'm very much dissatisfied with the college. Lecturers, labs and infrastructure need to be improved.

content.Placements: There were no placements for my batch. Not only my batch, but my juniors also didn't get placements. This is the worst college I had seen. I suggest you not to join this college. Don't spoil your life. There is no placement officer, and no soft skill classes are conducted. Even the ECE and CSE students have no placements. Only BPO companies like HGS visit the campus to offer placements.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of our college is average. The buildings, computer labs and library are being improved. The library has very less number of books, and the available books are very old and not updated.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2013
individual_reviews.title: Chiranjeevi Reddy Engineering College is okay and not that bad.

content.Placements: When I joined in Chiranjeevi Reddy College, there is only one batch before me. So, they started placement cell from 2012, and most of them got placement letters, but there is an issue with companies, so most of them came back. They need to increase standards in education, and they also need to improve the placement cell.
content.Infrastructure: The college needs to update labs and faculty members. There is no proper placement cell. We need soft skill trainers. There is project work. Standards of teaching staff are low. We also need to improve practicals. Management needs to concentration on staff and students. The classrooms are okay on the campus.

approved institution recognised by the Government of Andhra Pradesh as equivalent thereto.

individual_reviews.title: Now placements are going well in our college.

content.Placements: 30% of students are placed in our course. The highest package offered is 12 LPA, the lowest package is 2.5 LPA, and the average package is 4.5 LPA. Top recruiting companies for our course are Infosys, OPPO and Delhi TVs, etc. 50% of students got internships from our course and in Delhi TVs, and 20% of students got internships from our course and in Bimazed. Top roles offered in our course are embedded developers, hardware engineers, and software developers.
content.Infrastructure: Due to the increasing percentage of students, there are no classrooms for some students, so they are adjusting to labs. Wi-Fi facilities are above average in our department. Coming to the infrastructure, it looks above average. And discussing about food is okay.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: In our college, the campus placements vary from year to year.

content.Placements: I'm a CSE student. In our college, 75% of students will get placed, mainly in our branch. For our course, there are some top recruiting companies like Infosys, TCS, Cognizant, HCL Tech, and Synechron. Top roles offered in our course are mainly development, data analyst, and MEAN stack. The highest package in our course is 38 LPA, the average package is 6 LPA, and the lowest package is 3.6 LPA. 50% of students got internships from our course in companies like OPPO, VYMO, Qspiders, SIS, SkillIntern, and NXTSYNC.
content.Infrastructure: There is a good Wi-Fi facility, but sometimes it does not work properly; the remaining times it's okay. There are E-classrooms for every branch separately. Coming to the classrooms, the infrastructure is good, and also the classrooms are cleaned neatly. The library is not only a normal library, but we also have a digital library. It is very useful for us. In our college, we have three places for food: the mess, the canteen, and Cafe Panda. Good medical facilities are also available, and they conduct the BPL cricket every year.

highlights.summary:
Aachi Institute of Management and Entrepreneurial Development (AIMED) was established under Aachi Educational and Research Foundation, which was founded by Mr. A.D. Padmasingh Isaac, Chairman and Managing Director of Aachi Group of Companies, Chennai. The institute has a collaboration with Bharathidasan University, which is recognised by the University Grants Commission (UGC) and was established by the Government of Tamil Nadu in 1982.

AIMED aims to help the students in becoming successful entrepreneurs and business leaders in the coming future. And hence, it has designed all its courses in such a way that every student goes through all the functional and practical aspects of setting up a business and running it efficiently. The teaching pedagogy involves interactive class room sessions, including lectures, exercises, Group Discussions (GD), role plays, case studies, practice sessions, term projects, industrial visits, etc.

The faculty to student ratio at the institute is 1:8 and additionally, Aachi Institute of Management and Entrepreneurial Development also provides frequent guest lectures using both its in-house talents and external guest faculty. The institute offers PG diploma, certificate and Foreign Language courses.

The major highlights of Aachi Institute of Management and Entrepreneurial Development are tabulated below:

Check Aachi Institute of Management and Entrepreneurial Development placements

Admission to each programme offered at Aachi Institute of Management and Entrepreneurial Development is based on the academic performance of a student in the previous qualifying exams. The institute offers admission in online mode through its official website. Candidates need to register and fill the application form to apply for the programmes offered by Aachi Institute of Management and Entrepreneurial Development.

Aachi Institute of Management and Entrepreneurial Development offers postgraduate programmes such as PG diploma in Management and Entrepreneurship (PGDME) and Post Graduate diploma in Family Managed Business (PGDFMB) with a course duration of one and a half years each. In addition to this, the institute also offers short-terms courses such as certificate programme in Retail Sales and Foreign Language courses. The duration of certificate programme and Foreign Language is three months and one year, respectively.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. in Microbiology - Batch of 2022
individual_reviews.title: Our campus has good environment.

content.Placements: Around 5 students got placed in this course out of 35 students. The highest salary package offered was 3 LPA. The lowest salary package offered was 2 LPA. Top recruiting company was Diasys. Top role offered was sales officer. Internships were not conducted in this college.
content.Infrastructure: Our campus was very peaceful. Laboratory was well-equipped. Classrooms were well-ventilated. Hostels were good. Mess was also available. Medical facilities were provided. A first-aid box was also available. Sports were conducted such as volleyball, kabaddi, and basketball. Two playgrounds were available. A basketball court was available. There were two volleyball courts on our campus. There was a huge library and several books were available.

individual_reviews.course: B.Com. in Computer Application - Batch of 2020
individual_reviews.title: Review of Nadar Mahajana Sangam S. Vellaichamy Nadar College.

content.Placements: Placements were not good in this college. They conduct placements by local bodies. No MNCs visited our college to hire students. We expect placements from top MNCs but nobody knows about interviews.
content.Infrastructure: Hostels were average. The food quality was not good. The infrastructure was not innovative because they followed the same courses for the past 20 years. Mobile phones were not allowed in the hostel.
content.Faculty: Teachers were good. Most of them degrade students. The exam pattern was normal. Semester exams were not difficult.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. in Microbiology - Batch of 2022
individual_reviews.title: Our college has good infrastructure and faculty members.

content.Placements: Almost 90% of the students are placed in our course. The highest salary offered is Rs. 20,000 per month, and the lowest salary offered is Rs. 12,000 per month. Top recruiting company for our course is DiaSys. Around 80% of the students got placed in DiaSys company. Marketing manager, lab technician, and medical coder are the top roles offered in our course.
content.Infrastructure: Labs, smart classroom, library, multi media, land for growing plants, air-conditioned lab are the facilities available in our college. The infrastructure is too good. The quality of classrooms, hostels, and canteen is good and clean. The quality of food served is too good and tasty.

individual_reviews.course: B.A. in English Literature - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: I was disappointed one time in the office room. They have irritated me in 2021.

content.Placements: Our college is the best for the English and MBA departments. Many job opportunities are offered on our own campus. Placements are high for educated students. Our college promotes good quality students to survive in life. Our college encourages all the students to do good things in the future.
content.Infrastructure: Labs, library and canteen are good. The ladies' hostel is the best, and there is a hostel facility for men with a playground. The warden on our campus is very honest. They have an extra advantage to care for all the students inside the campus, and they have the best bonding with others. They like us more.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Commerce (B.Com.) - Batch of 2019
individual_reviews.title: Completely satisfied, good infrastructure and friendly staffs.

content.Placements: More than 90% of students got placement. 2.5 LPA is the highest package offered. Accountant is the highest role offered for our course. The average package is about 1 LPA. For UG programs there is no internships offered. BPO companies gave the major placement in 2019.
content.Infrastructure: College has an eco friendly and green environment. Canteen and mess food are almost like Homemade foods. You don't need to care about the quality of food. College has canteen. Both mess and canteen food taste same only. There is no noise pollution in the college area.

overview_faqs.question: Is Sri Sukhmani Institute of Engineering and Technology a good college/Institute?
overview_faqs.answer: Sri Sukhmani Institute of Engineering and Technology is a well-known institution for M.E./M.Tech, MBA/PGDM, MCA, B.E. / B.Tech courses. These programs are delivered by highly experienced faculty. As per Shiksha's verified reviews, Sri Sukhmani Institute of Engineering and Technology has a rating of 2.63 on the basis of Shiksha-verified reviews by students. Not just this, it has also been rated 2.38 on Campus Life, 2.07 on Placements, 3.13 on Faculty and 2.72 on Infrastructure.

review_summary.college_name: Sri Sukhmani Institute of Engineering and Technology Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: I am dissatisfied with the faculty members. There are no placements at all. The infrastructure is ok

content.Placements: I am in my second year now and no placements have happened till now. The placement rate is very low and almost negligible. Only one company has arrived for placements drive and that too is not exactly a company. Some private schools or institutes come for students to enroll in their different courses.
content.Infrastructure: The library has old books. Wi-Fi is not available. Labs and classrooms are okay just like in schools. No extra facilities are provided. Medical facilities are not available. Hostels are very hygienic and unclean. Food is also not that good. There is also no backup for electricity cuts.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: It is the best and most affordable college.

content.Placements: About 30% of students got placed in our college. The lowest salary package offered is 3 LPA, and the average salary package offered ranges between 6 LPA - 7 LPA. Top recruiting companies are Wipro, Accenture, Microsoft, and TCS.
content.Infrastructure: All classrooms and computer labs are very impressive. Our canteen provides only a few food items.
content.Faculty: Our teachers are highly qualified and helpful. They have 10-15 years of experience. They always clear our doubts. Semester exams are not difficult if you study well.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2013
individual_reviews.title: This was a college for a smart engineer.

content.Placements: Placements in our college were good. Companies from IT Park (Chandigarh), Infosys, Airtel, Ericson, and industries from an industrial area visited our college and hired students. Executive, assistant engineer, etc., were some of the roles offered by the companies. The highest package offered was about 7 LPA and the average package offered was in between 2 LPA to 3 LPA.
content.Infrastructure: Facilities like Wi-Fi, labs, library, medical facilities, sports grounds, indoor games, outdoor games, and all are available in the college. Teachers in our college were qualified enough for explaining the experiments in labs or computer labs. Delicious food items enriched in proteins and vitamins were provided to the students. There was Wi-Fi facility in the hostel. Overall, the infrastructure was good during my tenure.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2018
individual_reviews.title: Faculty and placements in our college are good.

content.Placements: I have completed my degree at Sri Sukhmani Institute of Engineering and Technology College. Many companies from different locations visit our college to offer placements. My friends got placed in different companies like Impinge, Infosys and many others. The college is good regarding placements.
content.Infrastructure: Our college provides the facilities like Wi-Fi, labs, library management, medical facilities etc. Every classroom looks very good. The college provides sports facilities like cricket, football, hockey etc. Our college has a canteen. The food offered in the canteen is awesome and tasty.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering - Batch of 2017
individual_reviews.title: Absolutely dissatisfied with everything in the college.

content.Placements: There are no placements for mechanical and civil branches. Last year, a company called Bluestar came for placements, but they want employees for marketing and sales. So, I think placements are not good in this college. I suggest to forget about placements in this college or find another college.
content.Infrastructure: The college infrastructure is very old. In the first visit, you can see a red building, it feels like you entered a government place. The campus is very small. The canteen is also very small. Food is not good, there are no varieties of food. So, I think the infrastructure is very bad. They have to do some improvement in it.

review_summary.college_name: CBS Group of Institutions Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Computer Application (BCA) - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: A drop year is better than this.

content.Placements: If we talk about the placements at this college, it's around 20% of the batch. They have a criteria of 70% marks and attendance around 75%; if not achieved, then you will not be able to sit in the placement drive. If the student is not proactive about the placements, then they might miss it. Students must be good in at least one language to land a job. The college organizes placement drives and interview drives for student placement, but very little placement is achieved by the MDU students because faculty don't look after them very much. More importance is given to the IPU students as compared to the MDU ones.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Computer Application (BCA) - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Do not take this course.

content.Placements: The placements in this college are close to zero, with this college being degree-entered and looking to just make the student graduate. Do not hope for any campus placements; the most you will get are notifications on WhatsApp about vacancies in various companies. One of the students in my batch got placed for around 3.5 LPA after 6 months of training. I never heard of any more from anyone else. Although students got internship opportunities easily, it was just about the same thing we learned in college, and there was barely any practical learning from them. There were roles offered for Java development, but none of the students got placed because of the high difficulty level of the interview.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: It is a good college with excellent faculty members.

content.Placements: Placements are very good. Almost 95% of students got placed in this course. The average salary package offered varies between 6 LPA - 8 LPA. The placement process is not easy as you have to be good in skills. If you are active in your studies, you will surely get placements.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is very good. Classrooms are well-maintained. Sports center is available. Our campus is Wi-Fi enabled. All the necessary facilities are available in this college. There is a huge library on our campus.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: It is a good college and I am satisfied with it.

content.Placements: Approximately 80% of the students got placed in our course. Mainly in the CSE branch, many students got placed. Top recruiting company for our course is mainly TCS. Almost 70% of students got internships from our course. Mainly in the coding part roles are offered.
content.Infrastructure: Facilities and infrastructure available for our course and department are decent or moderate. Labs are very large and approximately 100 students can sit at a time. Hostel facility is very good because the hostel staff is very familiar with us. Mess and canteen are also good but I would request to change sports facilities.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: Overall, our college is awesome.

content.Placements: I am studying a BBA course in our college, but I have scored average marks in both years. Some companies give more salary packages to our serious in our college. The internships are going on. The highest-paid companies are Wipro, Infosys, etc. A percentage is not needed to get an internship.
content.Infrastructure: In our college, labs and the library are good. Various types of games and sports are available in our college. Our college provides good facilities like a projector installed in classrooms. Extracurricular activities are also conducted in a week. Our canteen makes hygienic food like Rajma Chawal, Roti Sabji, etc.

review_summary.college_name: Shri Yogindra Sagar Institute of Technology and Science (SYSITS) Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Information Technology - Batch of 2022
individual_reviews.title: Dissatisfied, faculty are good, good environment, below average placement.

content.Placements: In my college, the placement ratio is below average. My class has 29 students, and only 3-5 people are placed. The highest is 7 LPA, the average is 2.5 LPA, and the lowest is 1 LPA annually. Top companies are TCS and Cognizant. I think everyone in my class has internships in different companies. In my case, I got an internship with an Indore-based company offering software solutions. I think top roles are developers, other than testers.
content.Infrastructure: Basic requirements of the facility are fulfilled like windows, rooms, fans, and other stuff like in a classroom. Yes, a projector is not there in every class; we have other rooms for projectors only. 1 or 2 projectors are there in college, and Wi-Fi is there but not allowed to connect your mobile. Yes, a library is very good, calm, and has a very good environment. Labs are there. Computer labs are awesome. You can code and run the internet, but you have access only on weekends. Laboratories are there for every subject. Laboratories are there. No hostel is available in this college or nearby, nor are any medical facilities nearby nor in college. Yes, first aid boxes are in the canteen, but only the food choices are there. Sports facilities are there every weekend. You can play whatever you want to play.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Civil Engineering - Batch of 2022
individual_reviews.title: The placements, facilities, and faculty in our are the best.

content.Placements: SYSITS RATLAM offers 18 courses in streams like engineering, management, science, arts, education, IT and 7 degrees like B.Tech, B.Ed, B.Sc., BBA and MBA. SYSITS RATLAM campus is spread over 10 Acres. The highest package offered is 12.4 LPA, and the lowest package is 2.5 LPA. IT companies come here for placements.
content.Infrastructure: Hostel facilities are not available for students. The campus has an auditorium, computer lab, gym, library, medical facilities, classrooms, sports, Wi-Fi, cafeteria, and laboratories. Our college conducts a big event, sports tournaments and other competitions. A canteen is available, and food quality is the best.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: No ragging but placements can be improved.

content.Placements: My seniors got placement packages up to 2.5L-3.25L and the average package is 2.5 Lakh. Out of 50 students, only 7-8 have been selected students. Top Recruiting companies are Wipro, Capgemini, IPCA, and Smart point. Percent of students getting internships is 40%-50%.
content.Infrastructure: Wi-fi is there and is only available for staff. There is a library in my college but not many books are not present in it. Hostel facility is not available. Breakfast is available in the canteen but it is expensive. Sports and games not there.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Civil Engineering - Batch of 2022
individual_reviews.title: It is the best engineering college in Ratlam city.

content.Placements: The training and placement cell of our institution plays a pivotal role in counselling and guiding students for their successful career placement. It is a crucial interface between the stages of completion of the academic program for the students and their entry into suitable employment.
content.Infrastructure: Our college does not have a hostel. In addition to lecture halls, tutorial rooms and drawing halls are available. The college has an auditorium, a library, computer centers, workshops, laboratories, playgrounds, an ATM facility, an extension counter of the post office, and a canteen.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: It is a very good college in Ratlam, Mandsaur and Neemuch area.

content.Placements: Our college has a very good placement cell but the institute is located in a very small town so top companies like TCS, and Wipro does don't provide on-campus placementS. But they accept the students of our college when we go for off-campus placements held in Indore every year.
content.Infrastructure: It does not have a hostel. But the college has some tie-ups with some local hostels. They are providing buses to reach the college from the hostel for free. In our stream, we have 3 computer labs with very good teachers.

reviews.review_text: Our college does not have a hostel. In addition to lecture halls, tutorial rooms and drawing halls are available. reviews.review_heading: It is a very good college in Ratlam, Mandsaur and Neemuch area.
reviews.review_text: It does not have a hostel. But the college has some tie-ups with some local hostels. They are providing buses to reach the college from the hostel for free. In our stream, we have 3 computer labs with very good teachers.

reviews.review_heading: Our college has value for money and I would recommend joining. it.

In a year, sports are organised only for 2 or 4 days.

reviews.review_heading: Average placement with simple infrastructure
reviews.review_text: The canteen of this college is pretty simple and good. Sports and games is also there in our college. The Wi-Fi, computer labs and chemistry lab is also provided by our college based on our department.

reviews.review_heading: The college is good, but the training and placement faculty are average.
reviews.review_text: The facilities are awesome. Wi-Fi doesn't work because it is limited only to 20Mb a day. Labs and classrooms are good. The library is not good. Hostels are not available. reviews.review_heading: Review of Shri Yogindra Sagar Institute of Technology and Science (SYSITS).

reviews.review_heading: Good institute to take admission in if the person wants to study in Ratlam.

reviews.review_heading: Out of all, this is the nice college to study in your Ratlam region.

individual_reviews.title: This is a college life for our future.

content.Placements: 50-60% of students are placed in my course from my college. The lowest package is 9 LPA, and the highest package is 15 LPA offered in my college for students. Top recruiting companies are Microsoft, TCS, Tata, and JCB. 15-30% of students get internships from my course at companies like Microsoft and Tata.
content.Infrastructure: The facilities provided by our college are very good. Infrastructure is very good and is in good condition. Students get free Wi-Fi, and the college campus has a big library and a big ground. Campus has a canteen that provides refreshments and snacks for students.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: I just say if you want degree then you take admission in that college .

content.Placements: In my college there no placement, only theory knowledge is studied in my college no practical knowledge given student that's why they are not capable for placements they have not trend skills and technologies to take placements and college also not take any company in college.
content.Infrastructure: Very bad scenerio of my college in terms of infrastructure and hostel it is located in highway but in the village there is not any type of public transport available and there is not any type of canteen available in my college the college building are also very old and hostel I thing not available .

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Civil Engineering - Batch of 2020
individual_reviews.title: I am absolutely satisfied and I recommend you to visit once before you get admitted to the college.

content.Placements: About 70% of students got internships or jobs from the college placement group and company. The highest salary package offered was 14 LPA and the lowest salary package offered was 4 LPA. We didn't have any top recruiting company but placements were held in our college. Some of our classmates also got placed.
content.Infrastructure: Basic amenities like a fan, window, charging socket, and others were provided by our college. Our college also provided Wi-Fi, labs for all courses, good classrooms with benches, and a huge library. I don't know anything about hostels but some of my classmates live in paying guest rooms. I didn't stay in PG but my friend who stayed there said that the mess and canteen were good but with strict timing. All sports, games, and medical facilities were available.

Directorate of Distance and Continuing Education, Utkal University, offers a plethora of UG, PG, certificate, and diploma courses across multiple streams. The popular programmes at DDCE Odisha include MBA and MA.
Admission to the MBA programme at DDCE is conducted on a first-come, first-served basis. The course curriculum includes Personal Contact Programmes (PCP) conducted for 10-15 days. individual_reviews.title: Absolutely satisfied with this course curriculum and college.

content.Placements: 60% of students were placed in my course. The highest package offered by the college was Rs 10,000 per month. content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of my college was very good and famous in my area. Free Wi-Fi, labs, classroom, and library were available. content.Placements: It is a distance course. There are a total of 60 students in the class, it provides specialisation too.
